detail.goal: Let a user view and change profile, notification, and account data - including the guarded, destructive deletion of the account.

steps.title: Account settings
steps.description: Grouped sections; the destructive zone is visually and semantically separated.

fields.name: newsletter
fields.label: Send me the monthly product newsletter

errors.message: Account deletion failed. Nothing was changed.
errors.recovery: Offer retry and a support contact link.

errors.message: Another account already uses this email.
errors.recovery: Keep other edits; focus the email field with the inline error.

detail.title: Action labels state the action
detail.description: Button labels describe what happens ('Create account', 'Place order'). Generic labels such as 'Submit', 'OK' or 'Yes' are forbidden.

detail.title: Destructive controls live in a separated danger zone
detail.description: Destructive controls are grouped in their own clearly titled card, never adjacent to routine save actions.

detail.title: Destructive confirmations state the consequence
detail.description: A destructive confirmation dialog states the irreversible consequence in body text, uses a danger-variant confirm button whose label repeats the action, and offers a safe cancel.

detail.title: Destructive actions require confirmation
detail.description: Hard-to-reverse actions (delete account, cancel subscription) never execute directly; they open a confirmation dialog first.

detail.title: Errors are textual and announced
detail.description: Validation errors render as text adjacent to the offending field and are announced to assistive technology (role=alert); color alone never signals an error.

detail.title: Every error state offers recovery
detail.description: Every error message is actionable, preserves user input, and tells the user what to do next. Dead-end errors are forbidden.

detail.title: Every field has a visible label
detail.description: Every form field has a non-empty, programmatically associated visible label. Placeholders never substitute for labels.

detail.title: Focus indicators are never suppressed
detail.description: All interactive elements show a visible focus ring using the color.border.focus token. Styles that remove outlines are forbidden.

detail.title: Layouts collapse below the md breakpoint
detail.description: Multi-column layouts collapse to a single column below breakpoint.md (768px). Forms are single-column at every width.

detail.title: Exactly one primary action per screen
detail.description: Each screen exposes exactly one primary-variant action so the user's next step is unambiguous. Supporting actions use the secondary variant.

detail.title: Personal-data fields declare autocomplete
detail.description: Fields collecting information about the user (name, email, address, payment card) declare the matching HTML autocomplete purpose.
